candidates.title: ARK: Avoiding Routing Collisions for KV Cache Transfer in Disaggregated LLM Inference
candidates.reason: prefill/decode分離で巨大KV transferがECMP hash collisionを起こす問題に対し、switch変更なしのdistributed elephant-flow path reservationを提案。RDMA simulationでP95 FCT最大34.0%、TTFT最大12.9%削減。

candidates.title: Co-Optimizing Request Scheduling and KV Caching for Edge LLM Serving
candidates.reason: multi-node edge LLMでKV blockを単位にcache placementとrequest schedulingを共同最適化し、spatiotemporal couplingをonline randomized roundingで解く。平均TTFT最大54.02%削減。

candidates.title: DuoPIM: RRAM–DRAM Hybrid PIM Acceleration for Flexible-Batch LLM Decoding
candidates.reason: LLM decodeでweight-intensive FCをRRAM PIM、cache-dependent attentionをDRAM PIMへ分担し、online softmax対応と階層的scheduleでbatch-size依存の資源利用問題を解く。PIM推論系統に直接関連。
